answer: A voyage is the disposable head. terrace is the admission graph where key, endpoint and sponsor edges share one node, so twins collide. Entry needs g sponsors from pairwise-disjoint sponsor sets; each locks oasis on the exact edge to that voyage, one backing edge per sponsor, slashed if two backed nodes share key or endpoint. With h usable honest sponsors, n voyage need n terrace nodes and roughly n·g/h bribed sponsors plus oasis. It fails if terrace dedups weakly, sponsor sets overlap, or oasis is lent.
